verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance SaaS platform, so an official CLI is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no Sprinto CLI. The `npx skills add gosprinto/compliance-skills` command installs agent skills through a generic skills installer rather than a Sprinto-provided command-line tool, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. The other material (dashboards, webhooks, APIs, AI editor) covers different capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
